digital.software_playback_reference: unity unless a profile explicitly documents attenuation

recording.rule: set analog gain from the loudest realistic performance, not from quiet speech or playing

analog.startup_rule: headphone amplifier and receiver volume start at minimum before a test signal is routed
analog.calibration_rule: raise one analog control at a time using a -20 dBFS signal

safe_sequence: set gain from loudest expected source
